load_model_mujoco: load a MuJoCo model from a file path, handling resources, plugins, and model overrides
init_structs_simulation: initialize Warp device structs for a MuJoCo simulation with model, data, render context, and control trajectory
unroll_simulation_step: unroll a simulation function over batched data with JIT capture, noise injection, and optional callback tracing
override_model_parameters: override MuJoCo model parameters using dot-notation strings for both MjModel and mjw.Model
replay_control_trajectory: replay a control sequence from an NPZ file to drive simulation steps with optional noise
